courses.overview: 以可遷移的傳力原理、施工方法與驗證比較相近的水利與海岸設施；關聯不表示同一業主、設計者、年代或規範。
courses.overviewEn: Compare neighbouring water and coastal works through transferable load-path principles, construction methods and verification; a link does not imply the same owner, designer, era or code.

related.title: 海水淡化鹵水擴散排放
related.transfer: 可遷移「產水需求與取水總量機理與驗證」與「堵塞演變與水頭損失機理與驗證」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；海水淡化鹵水擴散排放的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Product demand and intake volume mechanism and verification" and "Clogging evolution and head loss mechanism and verification" transfer, while hydraulic boundaries, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Brine diffuser outfalls for desalination must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦取水水量、生物介面與海岸水力驗證；海水淡化鹵水擴散排放則以從鹽量守恆到負浮力排放的多尺度驗證為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on intake balances, biological interfaces and coastal hydraulic verification; Brine diffuser outfalls for desalination centres on multiscale verification from salt conservation to negatively buoyant discharge, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「產水需求與取水總量」與「濃縮鹽量守恆」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到海水淡化鹵水擴散排放，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「孔距與噴流合併機理與驗證」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Product demand and intake volume” and “Concentrate salt conservation”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Brine diffuser outfalls for desalination, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Port spacing and jet merging mechanism and verification", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

related.title: 河岸取水口防淤設計

related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Product demand and intake volume mechanism and verification" and "Clogging evolution and head loss mechanism and verification" transfer, while hydraulic boundaries, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Sediment-resistant river intake design must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦取水水量、生物介面與海岸水力驗證；河岸取水口防淤設計則以以泥砂收支與局部水理協調河岸取水防淤為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on intake balances, biological interfaces and coastal hydraulic verification; Sediment-resistant river intake design centres on coordinating river-intake sediment budgets with local hydraulics, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「產水需求與取水總量」與「引水比例與季節工況」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到河岸取水口防淤設計，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「篩網方向與掃流機理與驗證」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Product demand and intake volume” and “Diversion fraction and seasonal states”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Sediment-resistant river intake design, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.

Using "Screen orientation and sweeping flow mechanism and verification", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 海水淡化取水工程
history.text: 海淡取水將供水能力、海洋環境與海岸地質連在一起，公開案例可用來比較調查方法而非移植尺寸。西澳伯斯奎那那廠於2006年開始產水，賓寧納普南部廠於2011年開始產水。加州於2015年將海淡取排水議題納入海洋計畫，後續地下取水專家報告須連同2025年主管機關回應閱讀，回應明示它不能作唯一合規指南。本課因此將公開歷史、研究限制與原創算例分開，不從單一海岸案例推定其他地點的取水可行性。
history.textEn: Desalination intakes connect supply capacity, marine ecology and coastal geology. Public cases support comparison of investigation methods rather than transfer of dimensions. Kwinana’s Perth plant began production in 2006 and the Southern plant at Binningup in 2011. California incorporated desalination intake and discharge issues into its Ocean Plan in 2015. A later subsurface-intake panel report must be read with the 2025 agency response, which states that it is not a sole compliance guide. This course separates public history, study limitations and original examples rather than transferring feasibility from one coastline to another.

history.title: 海水淡化取水工程
history.text: 伯斯奎那那海淡廠開始產水，形成海域取排水比較案例。
history.textEn: The Perth Kwinana plant begins production, providing a marine intake/outfall comparison.

history.title: 海水淡化取水工程
history.text: 賓寧納普南部海淡廠開始產水，連接區域供水系統。
history.textEn: The Southern plant at Binningup begins production and connects to regional supply.

history.title: 海水淡化取水工程
history.text: 加州主管機關回應地下取水報告，明示研究與合規依據的限制。
history.textEn: California’s agency responds to the subsurface-intake report, clarifying its limitations.

history.title: 從工程史到可驗證模型
history.titleEn: From engineering history to verifiable models
history.text: 本課把「產水需求與取水總量機理與驗證」到「排放回流與取水水質機理與驗證」改寫為 40 個原創分析、試驗與診斷任務；不複製來源圖片、影片逐字稿、設計圖或現場程序。
history.textEn: The course turns "Product demand and intake volume mechanism and verification" through "Outfall recirculation and intake quality mechanism and verification" into 40 original analysis, testing and diagnosis tasks without copying source images, video transcripts, drawings or field procedures.
